taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Privileged access management checkout, approval and revocation binding
controls.source_trace: Trace who can request which managed account and whether approval remains bound to resource, purpose, operator and time during use.
controls.implementation_branch: Separate approval, credential checkout, brokered session and actual privileged account lifetime. Closing a ticket may not promise immediate termination of every active session. Trace the declared expiry/revocation semantics and whether the same actor retains a prohibited capability; an audit event proves recording, not termination or least privilege.
controls.operational_method: Identify credential-disclosing checkout versus broker-only session access before selecting the revocation oracle. Retain account/approval binding, credential version, checkout expiry, rotation event and any reconnect capability. Compare a legitimate owned checkout/session with a stale checkout after the declared expiry/rotation rule. Closing a ticket does not universally terminate a tunnel or erase a disclosed password; the product contract decides which final capability should cease.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a local PAM stub and synthetic credential/session capability; compare approved checkout and wrong-account/stale-approval use.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Viewing a managed account name is not credential access; an approved privileged session is expected within its declared scope.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind approval and brokered use to current authority, verifying rotation/revocation and intended emergency access.
